scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.vercel-debug-build: echo '--- ENV ---' && node -v && npm -v && echo '--- list root node_modules .bin ---' && ls -la node_modules/.bin || true && echo '--- running workspace build ---' && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace shared
